_comment: SYNTHETIC DATA. Real Part 4 output, gated per team_correlations.json and team_structural_summary.json. No opt-in data exists in this pipeline by design — see opt_in_shares below.

opt_in_shares.suppressed_message: Opt-in sharing is not part of this pipeline — Part 3's privacy contract keeps individual insights out of Part 4 entirely, so nothing is ever escalated here.

never_shown: Any per-person biometric or calendar record

meeting_density.caption: Team average meetings per person, by weekday and time block.

causal_categories.structural_fact: The team averages 3.6 meetings per person per day.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Review whether recurring meetings this week can be shortened or made async.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 40.8% of meetings are scheduled back-to-back with no gap.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Run a workload check-in this week — back-to-back scheduling is elevated team-wide.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 31.2% of meetings have no agenda attached.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Encourage agenda-required norms for recurring meetings.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 6.5% of meetings fall outside standard working hours.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Check whether after-hours meetings are avoidable for most attendees.

causal_categories.structural_fact: 32.5% of days have no contiguous midday break.
causal_categories.recommended_action: Consider protecting a midday buffer window on the team calendar.
